All measurements, grouped into 24 local hours. The selected period and other filters do not affect this chart.

Visual aid, not a medical rule. With at least 7 distinct timestamps and 6 neighboring differences no more than 7 days apart, the threshold is max(0.5 kg, 3 × median absolute neighboring difference). A point is hidden only if it is strictly above or below both neighbors by more than the threshold, while the neighbors differ by no more than the threshold. Endpoints, tied timestamps, steady trends, lasting level changes and adjacent candidate groups remain. Filtering never deletes measurements. Automatic selection starts at 05:00–12:00 and moves one boundary by 30 minutes per iteration, at most 10 steps, to 2–3 hours; it needs sufficient data. Points outside the chosen hours are not outliers. Daily minimums use one complete measurement; an excluded minimum is not replaced.
